title: Briakos parser archaeology using a pre-existing external MDP parser family

parser_semantics_to_replay_exactly: regex find every occurrence matching [double-quoted-name, { across the entire JS text
for each match, locate the next opening brace with raw.index
naive character-level brace depth scan without string/comment awareness until depth returns to zero
on failure retry json.loads after global single-quote to double-quote replacement
on second failure silently skip the record
store successful values in a Python dict keyed by name, so later duplicate names replace earlier values

predeclared_comparisons: site histogram of all successful records versus Briakos published 419-site histogram
site histogram of external LEDGER subset versus Briakos published 419-site histogram
support histogram of each candidate population
whether candidate population can contain 37 source support == Stone vessel records

classification_rule.STRONG_CORPUS_IDENTITY_CANDIDATE: A fixed external candidate population matches 419 and the five named site counts, has exactly 15 sites with the residual ten-site total 35, and is not structurally incompatible with the published 299/37 support partition.
classification_rule.COUNT_ONLY_COLLISION: A candidate equals 419 but fails the site fingerprint or cannot structurally contain the published ceremonial group.
classification_rule.NO_MATCH: No fixed external population equals 419 and site fingerprint fails.
